config.notes:
SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-18: CQL — List Operators Part 1. Test these items: Contains(list, element), Distinct(list), Equal (List), Equivalent (List), Except (List), Exists(list), Flatten(list), First(list), In(element, list), Includes(list), Included In (list), IndexOf(list, element), Intersect (List). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 STU4 Appendix B 10.x (fetched this session) §10.6 Exists: returns true if the list contains any non-null elements
issues.evidence: `exists Patient.name.given` -> false for a patient with given names (reproducer .temp/qa/cql18_skeptic2/probe4.py (patient p1, name.given=[Jim,Peter]+[Jim])). Generated SQL uses `fhirpath_bool(resource,'name.given') IS NOT NULL` which is NULL for non-boolean collections. Silent wrong answer.
issues.root_cause: Dynamic multi-valued FHIR property operands lower to scalar fhirpath_text (first-node truncation); list operators compared/typed the wrong shape.
issues.resolution: Centralized _promote_fhirpath_text_list() in translator/expressions/_utils.py applied across list-macro helpers, Equivalent dispatch, Contains fallthrough, Exists fhirpath_bool branch, Distinct fallback, IndexOf dispatch, and new flatten pre-translate.
issues.verified_in: probe4 all 17 cases; new population-SQL regression test (py+cpp); master gate 2832/2832
